title: Behavioral Health Treatment Plan
about: A person-centered and family-centered treatment plan made with the person: goals in their own words, services and recovery supports, a crisis plan, advance directives and progress at each review. Written to SAMHSA's CCBHC criteria; states and payers add their own rules.

code.display: Mental Health Plan of Care Note

source.name: SAMHSA CCBHC Certification Criteria (2023, updated August 2025): 2.b.2, 3.a.4, 4.e.2 to 4.e.7

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.label: This plan is
items: The first plan, after the comprehensive evaluation
An update after a change in status, response to treatment or goals

blocks.text: Review and update this plan at least every 6 months, and whenever the person's status, response to treatment or goals change. A state, payer or accreditor may require reviews more often, or other signatures; follow the stricter rule.

blocks.label: Goals: what matters most to me, and what I want from care
My preferences: how, when, where and with whom I want care
What my family or caregiver adds, if I want them involved
Needs this plan addresses
items: Housing, food, transport or other social needs

blocks.label: Services, including recovery supports
columns: Who provides it (our clinic or a referral)

fields.label: Care setting (the least restrictive that meets the need)
Consultation sought (for example eating disorders, brain injury, I/DD, violence or trafficking)

blocks.label: Releases of information
items: All releases of information needed for this plan are signed and in the record

blocks.label: Warning signs that a crisis may be starting
What helps me, and what I can do
People I can call (name and phone)

blocks.text: In a crisis, call or text 988, the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, at any time. In an emergency, call 911.

fields.label: Local crisis line or mobile crisis team

blocks.label: Advance directive
items: Has a psychiatric advance directive (a copy is in the record)
Has another advance directive (a copy is in the record)
Was offered help to make one
Doesn't want to share their preferences (noted here)

blocks.label: Progress toward each goal
columns: Met, partly met, not met, or changed

blocks.label: Who took part in making this plan
columns: Role (the person, family, guardian, team member)

blocks.text: I helped make this plan. It says what I want from my care, and I agree with it.

signers: Parent or guardian (when one is needed)
Supervisor or approving licensed professional (when required)
